title: New in Symfony 8.2: Messenger Inbox
content:
<html><head></head><body>In a previous article, we introduced the Messenger outbox, which saves the
messages you send in the same database transaction as your changes. Symfony 8.2
adds the other half of the pattern: an inbox to keep track of messages your
application has already…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
